Why loss adjusting? → investigation leading to financial decisions.
Why leave after a year? → "delivered [X]; now seeking decision-making."
Why us? → recent deal (AM Group, HPC) + training path.
Explain BI → "Lost gross profit plus extra costs to keep trading, during the indemnity period."
EML? → "Largest loss if a key protection fails, under stated assumptions."
Lithium? → thermal runaway, re-ignition, toxic gases, segregation.
Military? → composure and accountability, not rigidity.

« Ingénieur en gestion des risques, je suis conseiller à la sécurité TMD dans un organisme public de recherche : j'audite les flux de marchandises dangereuses, j'analyse les incidents et je fais appliquer des actions correctives. Avant cela : deux ans d'alternance au Ministère des Armées sur les audits TMD et environnement, deux ans chez Eiffage Route sur la traçabilité des déchets, et quatre ans comme chef de groupe d'infanterie, dont des OPEX au Tchad et au Niger. Je veux mettre cette capacité d'enquête et ce calme sous pression au service de l'expertise des sinistres d'entreprise et transport. »

contenu: "I'm a risk and environmental engineer, currently Dangerous Goods Safety Adviser at a national public research organisation. I audit hazardous materials flows across classes 1 to 9, investigate incidents and drive corrective actions. Before that: two years of dangerous goods and environmental audits with the French Ministry of Armed Forces, two years on waste traceability at Eiffage Route, and four years as an infantry NCO section leader. I want to apply that field and audit experience to property risk assessment: hazardous storage, lithium batteries, fire protection."
